coverage_caveat: Most Power conferences mandate formal availability reports primarily for conference games. Big Ten midweek/gameday reports for league opponents do not begin until mid-September 2026. SEC and Big 12 policies similarly emphasize conference competition. Consequently, early-season (non-conference) weeks rely heavily on coach comments and beat reporting, and many FBS programs publish little or no comprehensive public list. Absence from this document is not evidence that a roster is healthy.
